title: Active-slice criterion for operadic free extension
statement:
Use the universes and monoidal infinity categories of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and presentability of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category]. Use ordinary nonsymmetric infinity operads and their inert maps as defined in [lem-coef-nonsymmetric-operads-presentability]. Let $u:\mathcal O\to\mathcal P$ be an inert-preserving map of small such operads. Let $\mathcal V^\otimes\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ be any monoidal infinity category; no presentability or cocompleteness is assumed. An algebra is a functor over $\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ preserving inert edges; their full functor infinity category is denoted $\operatorname{Alg}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal V)$. A base arrow is active if its opposite preserves the endpoints. Let $\mathcal O_{\mathrm{act}}$ be the wide subcategory of active arrows, and for $b\in\mathcal P_{[1]}$ put
$$K_b=\mathcal O_{\mathrm{act}}\times_{\mathcal P_{\mathrm{act}}}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{act}})_{/b}.$$
For an $\mathcal O$-algebra $A$, let $D_{A,b}:K_b\to\mathcal V$ send $(a,u(a)\to b)$, with $a$ over $[n]$ and successive inert colors $a_1,\ldots,a_n$, to $\bigotimes_{i=1}^n A(a_i)$, with value $\mathbf1$ for $n=0$; its arrows use the active algebra structure and composition of operations. Suppose, for every $A,b$, this diagram has a colimit and, for every pair of fixed objects $L,R\in\mathcal V$, the functor $x\mapsto L\otimes x\otimes R$ preserves this colimit. The tensor unit may be used for $L$ or $R$, so one-sided tensoring is included. Then restriction $u^*$ has a coherent left adjoint $u_!$, with
$$(u_!A)(b)\simeq\operatorname{colim}_{K_b}D_{A,b},\qquad \operatorname{Map}(u_!A,B)\simeq\operatorname{Map}(A,u^*B),$$
naturally in $A,B$. The adjunction unit is the cocone map associated to the identity operation of $u(a)$; the extension uses operadic substitution. All diagrams, colimits and adjunctions are homotopy coherent.
